snippet.title: Bitvoxel Gameplay trailer
snippet.description:
BITVOXEL is a 3D voxel logic sandbox where you can build circuits, create reusable components, and experiment with digital logic in a fully 3D world.

Place blocks, wire signals, build gates, save modules as components, and use your own creations to make bigger and more complex systems. BITVOXEL is still in development, with new tools, UI improvements, Steam integration, and the early roots of a Career Mode / learning center being worked on.

Steam page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4855960/BitVoxel/
